description: This Swift source file defines the DeviceModelCatalog enum, which provides functionalities to map device identifiers and device families to user-friendly presentations and symbolic representations. It includes methods for loading device data from JSON resource files, and functions for determining device symbols based on identifier prefixes and fallback logic.

classes.name: NameValue
classes.description: A Decodable enum representing either a string or an array of strings, used for decoding device identifiers from JSON resources.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Generates a DevicePresentation object containing a user-friendly title and symbolic icon for a device given its family and model identifier.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines and returns the symbolic icon name for a device based on its raw family and model identifier strings, and an optional friendly name.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Returns a symbolic icon string based on the device model identifier and friendly name, using prefix matching to identify device types.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a default symbol based on device family when no specific symbol can be determined.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads and merges device identifier mappings from JSON files into a dictionary.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Reads a JSON resource file and decodes it into a dictionary mapping device identifiers to names.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Attempts to identify and return the appropriate resource bundle containing device JSON files for the project environment.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks whether a given bundle contains device identifier JSON files for iOS or Mac devices.
